rules.count: declared count: the integer right after "Answer:" in the delivered answer; official scores unchanged
rules.label_map: per-item state: an executed repl_eval source that binds or updates (def / atom / swap! / reset! / into / conj) a map, set or vector literal holding >= 10 integer item ids, or builds a def with zipmap / into {} / assoc / merge / reduce-kv
rules.computed_answer: the submitted number appears as a value in a tool result before done
rules.audit: an executed source that calls audit-labels; its returned map, when shown, gives open/unknown/conflict counts
